svg.title: AgentVoice: database sync, private backup and message delivery
svg.desc: Proposed architecture. Read-only MCP is confirmed on iPhone Live voice. All storage, authorization and queue components shown here remain to be built and tested.

g.text: Your sessions. Away from your Mac.
One local OpenCode. Two cloud data stores. Two message queues.
One database, two very different cloud copies
The backup is not the database that ChatGPT searches.
Code waits for the Mac to return.
Private chats · other sessions · arbitrary files · backup key · local API credentials
Sync the changes, not the whole history
Two kinds of “diff”: conversation rows for talking, SQLite pages for recovery.
* First backup is full. Periodic baselines / recovery can read more. Numbers above are illustrative.
The database is still readable on your Mac. The cloud backup is not.
Important: current Litestream cannot encrypt cloud replicas itself. The restic layer is deliberate.
Yes, these are real messages to your existing session
“Send this” starts work when allowed. Brainstorming alone does not.
YOU: “Send this to the session: implement the retry change.”
Accepted ≠ completed. Replies return through normal context sync. Saved drafts do not enter the agent inbox.
You talk with ChatGPT using its saved context. The coding agent is not running in the cloud.
See its age, not a fake “live” status
Revocation stops new access/delivery. It cannot recall data already seen by ChatGPT or undo work already started.
What is built, and what must pass before real data
No production chat upload is authorized by this plan.
iPhone confirmed by you · no real DB attached
Wrong-user rejection · offline read · no duplicate input · encrypted canary · source I/O + writer latency
Measured backup age and sync age are separate. Heartbeats do not prove either one.
DESIGN, NOT A DEPLOYMENT • No private chat content appears in this diagram.
